## How to read this

A redundant search is not an error. The controller's own declared stop condition is two searches adding nothing, so some redundancy is the mechanism working. The rate says how much of a bounded budget went on ground already covered.

Open edges are unchecked inferred edges (no verifier verdict), not every unsupported edge. The controller orders all open edges shallow-first; it has no separate binary high-priority threshold, so these counts cover the entire priority queue. Checked rejections are resolved for this controller. Read the count beside the stop reason: `budget_exhausted` with open edges means the budget prevented completion. Fixed prose/prompted baselines do not run this controller; their stop labels do not indicate that it judged remaining edges unimportant.

Conditions without an agent loop (A-NoLoop and the fixed baselines) retrieve at most once per query, so their redundant-search rate is undefined rather than zero.
